method: Fourth-order Butterworth bandpass, forward-backward filtering; per-channel mean square in fixed adjacent pre/post spans of 10,20,40ms around original RMS frame center. No peak search or optimization of anchor.
criterion: Exploratory >3dB growth in both channels at all three spans; not calibrated physical-attack classification.
limitations: Zero-phase filtering smears transients, especially low frequencies.
Same source and selected RMS candidates; not independent ground truth.
Growth can be modulation/interference; does not identify instrument, player, or exact onset.
